description: This file defines a Flutter StatefulWidget called HomeShell that manages bottom navigation between four different screens: Dashboard, Workouts, Goals, and Profile. It includes UI layout with gradient background and a bottom navigation bar, and initializes some app state on startup.

classes.name: HomeShell
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that serves as the home container with bottom navigation for different sections of the app.

classes.name: _HomeShellState
classes.description: State class managing the current index and page display for the HomeShell widget.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the HomeShell widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state and loads initial app data asynchronously.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including the gradient background, scaffold, IndexedStack for pages, and bottom navigation bar.
